column3: Booming Professors and Earthfathers fit; Sharpen and Broken Obol do not.
Mushroom Cloud and Rapala fill enemy deck or hand; District X and The Raft do not.
Kraken and Emissary (Disloyal) and Airdrop cards place on his side; Hellfire Club only restricts play.
Tusk Boar and Yak Attack have Rush/Haste; Kerack Cutthroat has no immediate action.
Event Horizon and Annie only stun briefly; Provoke and Taunt cards do not lock anything.
All eight have Ranged, e.g. Heartseeker and Siege Engine.
Alloyed Construct (Multistrike) and Lucian (Double Attack) act twice; Celerity only adds movement.
